current.text: New York won the championship last season, beating the Spurs in the Finals.
The Knicks are expected to be cautious with their main players' minutes after last season's extended workload. Towns and Anunoby are named.
Over about the first 30 games, the team is expected to trim its starters' minutes and rest them more on back-to-backs.
The experts see some risk of a Finals hangover after two extra months of play. That could mean a minute or two less per game and a small rise in injury risk.
The Knicks are projected as a top East team. Expert win projections range from about 50 to 54, and the market win total ranks third in the league.
The projected starters are Brunson, Bridges, Hart, Anunoby and Towns.
The team is expected to use few double-big lineups, so Towns should be the only big in most starting minutes.
Andre Drummond replaces Mitchell Robinson as the backup center.
The team was short a third big. It brought in James Wiseman, Drew Eubanks and other camp signings, and one or two of them are expected to make the roster.
Ownership does not want to go over the second apron. The team has little cap room, so big additions are unlikely.
The Knicks have 13 back-to-backs, the fewest in the league. That limits rest risk for their starters once the early caution ends.
The fantasy playoff schedule is average: 10 games in weeks 19 to 21, with one back-to-back each week and 4 games in week 21.

durable.text: Under Mike Brown, the Knicks play their bench more and do not overwork the starters the way the previous coach did.
Mike Brown gives Towns fewer minutes than Thibodeau did.

tags.new_meaning: The team is expected to trim its healthy starters' minutes or rest them more than usual this season.

note: All five Knicks starters (Brunson, Bridges, Hart, Anunoby, Towns) should play fewer minutes and rest more on back-to-backs over about the first 30 games. Expect a slow start and pay for their full-season value, not their early weeks. Drummond is the main handcuff behind Towns. Early on, watch how many minutes the starters get and which camp big (Wiseman or Eubanks) makes the roster.
